rootCauseOneLine: apps/app/src/components/ui/markdown-code-highlight.ts maps only rust/python/go/c/java/css fence languages to sugar-high v1 presets; sh/bash/shell/zsh/console (and yaml, toml, sql, diff, ...) get preset=undefined and fall through to sugar-high's JavaScript lexer, so `#` is a sign, words are identifiers, and `/plugins/monokai` is a regex-literal string.
proposedFix: Preferred: bump apps/app sugar-high to ^2.0.1 and in markdown-code-highlight.ts replace the preset map with `import { lang } from "sugar-high/lang"` -> `highlight(code, { lang: lang(language) ?? EXTRA_ALIASES[language] })`, with EXTRA_ALIASES covering h/hpp->c(pp), less->css, console->shell (verified: lang() maps sh/bash/zsh/shell->shell and 25 langs incl. yaml/toml/sql/diff/json; HTML still uses sh__token--* / --sh-* so the CSS is untouched; only this file imports sugar-high). Alternative minimal v1 patch: add a local shell preset (python-style `#` comment handlers + shell keywords) mapped from sh/bash/shell/zsh/console and wire the shipped `diff` preset; fixes comments but v1's regex-literal heuristic still paints unquoted paths like ./plugins/monokai as strings.
caveats: No linked PR to review (PR #1317 is a Streamdown PoC referenced only as evidence). Minor issue inaccuracy: sugar-high 1.2.1 ships seven presets (no json), not eight. Screenshots are light theme only. Worktree was moved to base 16ceb3a54 (HEAD was origin/main a108fa7ef, which does not touch the relevant files, so not fixed upstream). Two untracked repro test files remain in the worktree under apps/app/src/components/ui/.
